title: Project Adamski
description: Project Adamski is a work in progress magic mod currently featuring a fully functional Meteor Strike staff. The ultimate goal of this mod is to build a full RPG magic system where players hunt mobs and explore the world, and get stronger with stafffs.
body:
Welcome to Project Adamski -
Project Adamski is a combat focused magic mod for Fabric 1.21.1, designed to bring powerful staffs and magic.

Currently its in early development stages, this mod establishes the foundation for a much larger RPG magic system. my goal is to make magic feel impactful, intuitive, and seamless to use during fast paced combat.

Current Features
The Beginner Staff: only has meteorite spell.
Interactive Radial UI: custom coded spell wheel, By holding the 'R' key you can open an on screen radial menu to quickly switch between your equipped abilities without ever having to pause or open your inventory.

Meteor Strike: currently available in the game. Select this ability from your radial menu, fiery meteorite from the sky, causing a massive explosion exactly where you aim.

The Future Roadmap
While the mod currently features a foundational staff and spell combo, massive updates are in the works! Future versions of Project Adamski will introduce a full progression system, meaning players will have to earn their power. Planned features include:

Spell Discovery: Exploring the world to find ancient spell scrolls hidden away dungeons.

Magical Progression: Gathering rare elemental materials and mob drops to craft new magical abilities.

Staff Upgrades: Forging higher-tier staves to unlock more slots on your radial spell wheel, eventually allowing you to seamlessly swap between four completely different elemental attacks in the middle of a fight.
